prompt: What does the man suggest the woman do to check whether the film is the cause?
promptZh: 男方建議如何確認問題是否由保護膜造成？

options.text: Peel the film off all of the panels from the shipment.
options.zh: 撕掉整批飾板的保護膜。
options.whyZh: 出貨飾板的保護膜先保留。

options.text: Send the panels back before examining the spare strips.
options.zh: 先退回飾板，之後才檢查備用試片。
options.whyZh: 男方說先別退貨，先用試片檢查。

options.text: Move the cloudy panel away from the lamp and leave both strips alone.
options.zh: 把霧霧的飾板移離燈光，兩片試片都不動。
options.whyZh: 須撕掉其中一片試片的膜，不是把飾板移離燈。

options.text: Remove the film from one spare strip and leave the film on the panels from the shipment.
options.zh: 撕掉其中一片備用試片的膜，保留出貨飾板的膜。
options.whyZh: 男方限制只動一片試片，出貨飾板不撕膜。

explanationZh: 男方限制只動一片試片，出貨飾板不撕膜。
evidence: Not yet. The panels come with a clear protective film. It can look cloudy by itself. We have two spare strips cut from the same material. Try peeling the film off one strip. Leave the film on the panels from the shipment for now.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M

vocabulary.note: covering 可在檢驗前先保留，用備用試片比較。
